const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboTwin limited-mode press_stapler controller.
+
+Run once with `python /app/output/gen.py approach`, inspect the saved view, then
+run `python /app/output/gen.py press` to make the pressing motion.  The target is
+recovered from the saved camera observation; no simulator state is queried.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+TARGET_FILE = os.path.join(OUT, "stapler_target.json")
+
+
+def obs_target(obs):
+    """Unproject a selected point on the stapler's top surface into world xyz."""
+    cams = obs.meta["cameras"]
+    cam = cams["head_camera"]
+    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    E = np.asarray(cam["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    # The top plate is the flat bright region visible around this pixel.
+    u, v = 130, 106
+    raw = float(obs.depth["head_camera"][0, v, u])
+    # RCB depth is millimetres in this scene (values around 700-850).
+    zc = raw / 1000.0 if raw > 10 else raw
+    pixel = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*zc/K[0, 0],
+                      (v-K[1, 2])*zc/K[1, 1], zc])
+    xyz = np.linalg.solve(E[:3, :3], pixel - E[:3, 3])
+    return xyz, (u, v, raw)
+
+
+def vertical_press_quat():
+    # In the ALOHA end-effector frame, local +x is the finger approach axis.
+    # This quaternion maps +x downward in world coordinates.
+    return np.array([np.sqrt(0.5), 0.0, np.sqrt(0.5), 0.0])
+
+
+def pack_pose(left, right):
+    return np.r_[left, right].astype(np.float32)[None, :]
+
+
+def save_result(res, name):
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, name)
+    res.save(path)
+    print("saved", path)
+    print("meta", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2)[:7000])
+
+
+def approach():
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none", include_depth=True)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "initial"), exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(os.path.join(OUT, "initial", cam + ".png"))
+    xyz, source = obs_target(obs)
+    target = {"xyz": xyz.tolist(), "pixel": list(source[:2]),
+              "depth_raw": source[2], "created": time.time()}
+    with open(TARGET_FILE, "w") as f:
+        json.dump(target, f, indent=2)
+    print("surface target", target)
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = vertical_press_quat()
+    # Finger centre is 12 cm forward of the EE frame, so this places it about
+    # 10 cm above the observed top plate.
+    left = np.r_[xyz[0], xyz[1], xyz[2] + 0.12 + 0.10, q, 1.0]
+    right = np.r_[p[21:24], p[24:28], 1.0]
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", pack_pose(left, right), video="both",
+                   video_fps=10, note="Move left gripper above stapler")
+    save_result(res, "approach")
+
+
+def press():
+    r = Robot()
+    with open(TARGET_FILE) as f:
+        target = np.asarray(json.load(f)["xyz"], dtype=float)
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    q = vertical_press_quat()
+    right = np.r_[p[21:24], p[24:28], 1.0]
+    # Lower in small steps: contact, then a short downward press and release.
+    # The nominal plate height comes from the camera depth point.
+    poses = []
+    for dz in (0.12 + 0.015, 0.12 + 0.005, 0.12 - 0.015):
+        left = np.r_[target[0], target[1], target[2] + dz, q, 1.0]
+        poses.append(np.r_[left, right])
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video="both",
+                   video_fps=12, note="Lower onto and press the stapler")
+    save_result(res, "press")
+    # Hold pressure briefly and release to the safe pre-contact height.
+    obs2 = r.get_obs(seconds=0.6, video="both", video_fps=12)
+    save_result(obs2, "press_hold")
+    p2 = np.asarray(obs2.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    right2 = np.r_[p2[21:24], p2[24:28], 1.0]
+    left = np.r_[target[0], target[1], target[2] + 0.22, q, 1.0]
+    res2 = r.submit("ee_pose", pack_pose(left, right2), video="both",
+                    video_fps=10, note="Lift after press")
+    save_result(res2, "release")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "approach"
+    if stage == "approach":
+        approach()
+    elif stage == "press":
+        press()
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: gen.py [approach|press]")
*** End Patch";
